title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper.

analysis.description: This paper provides an analysis of well-known word embedding algorithms like Word2vec and GloVe by deconstructing them into a common framework. The research aims to offer theoretical insights for developing future language models by exploring the relationship between word embeddings and pointwise mutual information (PMI).

type.justification: The paper offers a theoretical retrospective on word embedding algorithms and aims to provide a theoretical basis for future model development.
type.quote: we propose a retrospective on some of the most well-known word embedding algorithms...we believe that the theoretical findings in this paper can provide a basis for more informed development of future models.

name.justification: The focus on word embedding algorithms places this research firmly within the field of Natural Language Processing.
